part.name: OD-E01_Power-PCB
part.what_it_is: Populated appliance power PCB (board id PCB00572-01): board, heatsink with a TO-220 and spring clip, electrolytic and film capacitors, faston tabs, connectors and SMD parts, delivered as ONE fused envelope solid of the component side for enclosure / fit design.

method_summary: Intake: full-resolution scan hashed, noise floors measured, datum = PCB top face (z 0, +Z out of the component side), mounting hole H1 axis as origin, +X along the long board edge (clock on the +X short edge).

Measure: seeded height map plus per-part fits on the frozen datum-frame scan (run-local measure/measure_pcb.py): edge-line fits for the board, bore-wall circle fits for holes, side-wall faces for tall boxes, per-z-bin circle fits for the leaning cans, profile fits for the heatsink, SDF fit for the Y-capacitor; every value in measure/params.json with its estimator.

Rebuild: params-driven build123d model (build/model.py): board plate with slot and holes, one extruded heatsink profile, cans revolved on their measured axes, boxes and wires for the rest, one union; exported in the datum frame and the scan frame.

Verify: independent fresh-context QA with its own ICP and two-way deviation on the full-resolution scan; iteration 1 REVISE (five geometry findings), iteration 2 BAND_NOT_MET, accepted by the owner for delivery (decisions/accept_band_it2.md).

limitations.text: No Tier-1 (no calipers run): scan-only job, every requested dimension is ABSENT, not passed; absolute scale is not caliper-verified (units assumed mm).
limitations.rerun_trigger: caliper readings for ENV-X, ENV-Y, F01 (H1 diameter), F02 (H1-H2 pitch) and F03 (board thickness) entered in input/MEASUREMENTS.md

limitations.text: Unscanned surfaces are invented: the whole solder side (board bottom), deep heatsink fin and spine sides and roots, connector cavity floors, lower can walls between the caps, undersides of raised parts and the Y-cap back. They drive the observable CAD-to-scan miss (p95 {{gate:deviation.cad_to_scan_observable.p95}} / max {{gate:deviation.cad_to_scan_observable.max}} mm); the solder-side mask alone removes a fraction {{gate:deviation.masks.0.fraction}} of the CAD samples.
limitations.rerun_trigger: a solder-side scan and oblique scans between the heatsink fins and caps

limitations.text: QA ICP bias: with the golden ICP parameters the invented board bottom corresponds to the scanned board top, so the ICP lifts the CAD (correction {{gate:registration.delta_mm}} mm) and the official scan-to-CAD reads p95 {{gate:deviation.scan_to_cad.p95}} / max {{gate:deviation.scan_to_cad.max}} mm; in the builder datum frame the same statistic reads p95 {{gate:deviation_datum_frame.scan_to_cad.p95}} / max {{gate:deviation_datum_frame.scan_to_cad.max}} mm.
limitations.rerun_trigger: a solder-side scan, or an owner / skill decision on the ICP correspondence radius or a signed normal test for thin plates with one invented face (QUESTIONS.md §F)
limitations.evidence: qa/gate.json#limitations.2; qa/gate.json#auto_limitations: datum-frame vs post-ICP scan_to_cad p95 differ by 0.471 mm (> band 0.3 mm)

limitations.text: Board warp is not modelled: the board is a flat design-intent plate while the scanned board top is bowed / twisted by a few tenths of a millimetre (worst at the H1 corner).
limitations.rerun_trigger: the owner asks for the as-scanned warped board, or an enclosure fit check needs the warp

limitations.text: QA ICP did not converge at its default iteration cap; the cap was raised once (same reason as iteration 1) and it converged; both runs are kept.
limitations.rerun_trigger: any rebuild: re-run ICP with the same cap and report both runs again

limitations.text: The photos are catalogue / installed photos; photos 2-4 show a variant heatsink without the spring clip, so heatsink, clip and spine details are confirmed by photo 1 only.
limitations.rerun_trigger: photos of the scanned unit (top, both heatsink sides, spine top)

limitations.text: A scanned surface inside the heatsink spine above the TO-220 tab is not modelled (real slot or reconstruction artefact is undecided); it holds the largest datum-frame scan-to-CAD residual after the edge fringe.
limitations.rerun_trigger: a side photo / oblique scan of the spine above the TO-220 tab, or an owner statement

limitations.text: Simplifications with a deviation cost: SMD terminations, solder fillets and lead toes below half part height are not modelled; lead bends are straight segments with square knuckles; can tops are flat (vent crosses and rim crimp omitted); the Y-cap is a rounded disc without its epoxy necks.
limitations.rerun_trigger: a use that needs pad-level or lead-level geometry

assumptions.text: Heatsink root stands on the board top (fin roots hidden).
TO-220 lead cross-section and through-hole lead wire diameter are standard values.
Every sub-body is embedded slightly into the board top (and the TO-220 tab into the spine) so the union has no coplanar faces (documented clearance in build/model.py).
The board bottom is an invented flat face at the measured board thickness below the datum top face.

not_fit_for: manufacture, tooling, PCB footprint or electrical work
solder-side or board-thickness-critical fits (the solder side is invented, scale not caliper-verified)
fits that depend on hidden geometry: heatsink fin roots and sides, connector cavities, part undersides
fit_for: component-side envelope and clearance studies for an enclosure (lid heights, part positions, mounting holes, faston access), with the band miss and limitations above in mind

repro_commands: python3 build/model.py   (from the run root; writes build/*.step, *_cad.stl, export_check.json)
python3 measure/measure_pcb.py && python3 measure/make_params.py   (re-derives measure/params.json from intake/aligned_work.stl)

feature_tree.feature: heatsink extruded profile (hubs with C-channels, spine, fins) - spine notch - screw hole
TO-220 body, tab with hole, bent leads
spring clip strap and lower hook
electrolytic cans (base, groove, body on a leaning axis), C1 V-chip base, C5 stem
6 faston tabs (chamfered blade, detent hole, foot)
axial parts along Y with leads
